name: research-native-namespace
purpose: Observe a moved research kind on the native route (research-native-namespace-k161). The sandbox home adds the marketplace of the prepared Grove checkout at the removal commit and installs research@linkuistics from it, which installs grove as a dependency. The Ravel settings have no skills key. A research-a leaf has the bare-name mandate. Expect the Skill tool to load research:grove-research-a, then the spine and research-family under their own namespaces, before the first action.
